description: An opaque russet floor-length gown has a low square neckline, fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves, and narrow patterned gold-toned borders at the neck, cuffs, front opening, and hem. A cream underdress is visible along the central skirt opening. A brown belt with a round ornamental clasp and long metal-tipped hanging strap secures the waist. A cream bordered wrap rests loosely on the forearms, and brown shoes appear below the hem.
